disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. title.zh: 未安装 serve-sim 时经 npx 执行未锁版本的外部包
title.en: When serve-sim is not installed, npx executes an external package without a pinned version

description.zh:
机制：当本地未安装 serve-sim 包时（依赖声明为 ^0.1.45，真实安装由锁文件固定版本），模拟器流宿主以 npx -y serve-sim 作为回退启动路径（src/sim-host.ts:228），每次控制调用都会经 npm 解析并执行 registry 上的最新版本，无版本锁定。

触发面：serve-sim 未随插件安装时（如开发树、精简安装、或依赖未正确 hoisted），任意 ios_sim_* 模拟器控制工具调用即触发 npx 远程解析。

位置：src/sim-host.ts:110 定义包名常量 SERVE_SIM_PACKAGE = 'serve-sim'，:228 构造 npx 参数 args ['-y', 'serve-sim']。
description.en:
Mechanism: when the serve-sim package is not installed locally (dependency declared as ^0.1.45, actual install version fixed by lockfile), the simulator streaming host starts via npx -y serve-sim as fallback path (src/sim-host.ts:228), each control invocation resolves and executes the latest version from registry via npm, without version pinning.

Trigger surface: when serve-sim is not installed with the plugin (e.g., dev tree, minimal install, or dependency not properly hoisted), any ios_sim_* simulator control tool invocation triggers npx remote resolution.

Location: src/sim-host.ts:110 defines package name constant SERVE_SIM_PACKAGE = 'serve-sim', :228 constructs npx args ['-y', 'serve-sim'].

evidence.zh: src/sim-host.ts:228 `return { available: true, source: 'npx', command: npx, args: ['-y', SERVE_SIM_PACKAGE] }`；src/sim-host.ts:110 `const SERVE_SIM_PACKAGE = 'serve-sim'`；回退警告 src/index.ts:373-378。
evidence.en: src/sim-host.ts:228 `return { available: true, source: 'npx', command: npx, args: ['-y', SERVE_SIM_PACKAGE] }`; src/sim-host.ts:110 `const SERVE_SIM_PACKAGE = 'serve-sim'`; fallback warning src/index.ts:373-378.

impact.zh:
后果：若 npm registry 上 serve-sim@latest 被投毒，插件会在用户机器上以用户权限执行该外部包的最新代码，形成供应链代码执行面。

触发条件：serve-sim 未被本地安装（该回退路径已由 README 文档化且插件自身会发出警告）；需要 registry 侧先被攻陷。

定级依据：无恶意证据、用途与插件声明业务自洽（serve-sim 是声明依赖的同一包名），属未锁版本远程执行的真实供应链卫生风险，但达成危害需要外部 registry 被攻陷，达不到 HIGH/CRITICAL（后者需要恶意实证或利用链完整），故定 MEDIUM。
impact.en:
Consequence: if serve-sim@latest on npm registry is poisoned, the plugin would execute the external package's latest code on the user's machine with user privileges, forming a supply chain code execution surface.

Trigger condition: serve-sim not locally installed (this fallback path is documented in README and the plugin itself issues a warning); requires the registry side to be compromised first.

Severity basis: no malicious evidence, purpose self-consistent with plugin's declared business (serve-sim is same package name as declared dependency); it is a real supply chain hygiene risk of unpinned remote execution, but achieving harm requires external registry compromise, falls short of HIGH/CRITICAL (which need malicious proof or complete exploit chain), so rated MEDIUM.
